ctx.x: Uh-huh. [affirmative] See, like we, like, say we go, like I did this thing with Tito and we would go, like we'd play Athens. And then we'd get up early that morning 'cause then we'd have to go to Istanbul. And then we'd play Istanbul, then we'd take the plane the next day and then we'd go to France, okay?
